sources.title: Introducing Claude 4
sources.evidence: May 22, 2025 launch names Claude Opus 4 and Anthropic; confirms extended thinking, parallel tool use, coding and sustained agent workflows.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4
sources.evidence: Sections 1 and 1.1 describe hybrid reasoning, visual analysis and tool use; the card does not disclose a model parameter count.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: Methods explicitly lists production Opus 4 separately from Opus 4.1 and helpful-only variants; interventions operate on layer residual streams. Discussion describes attention heads and transformer-based models. Supports broad transformer classification, without disclosing dense/MoE topology or parameter counts.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by restrictive commercial terms; reverse engineering and duplication are restricted and no general intellectual-property rights are granted. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification, not a weight license.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used only for Claude distribution policy, not technical specifications of Opus 4.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Exact Opus 4 provider documentation lists text/image inputs, text output, a 200,000-token context, function calling and extended thinking. Accessed through the legacy URL after the newer URL returned a fetch error; these are documented specifications, not evidence of current endpoint operation.

sources.title: Citations API and PDF support for Claude models now in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: June 30, 2025 announcement explicitly lists Claude Opus 4 as supporting PDF document processing through Invoke Model and Converse APIs.

sources.title: System Card Addendum: Claude Opus 4.1
sources.evidence: Later card compares Opus 4 and Opus 4.1 but does not disclose total or active parameter counts for Opus 4.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 4.5
sources.evidence: Later card checked for parameter-count disclosures and comparisons; no Opus 4 total or active count found. Retrieved with curl and searched via pdftotext after the web tool rejected its file size.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Maps Claude Opus 4 to claude-opus-4-20250514 and states retirement on the Claude API on June 15, 2026.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Parent checked the exact Claude Opus 4 API pricing table: it lists both 200K and 1M tiers, conflicting with retained model/provider context specifications. The pricing row alone does not establish when or on which access tier 1M was available.

name.note: Official launch name; deprecation documentation identifies the exact dated API snapshot.

developer.note: Named developer in the original system card.

family.note: Normalized catalog family for the officially named Claude Opus line.

release_date.note: Explicit public launch date; the 20250514 snapshot suffix is not its release date.

open_weights.note: Exact model launched through hosted products; explicit later Claude-wide weight non-distribution policy corroborates closed weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of closed commercial access; not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total count disclosed in the original card or the later Opus 4.1 and 4.5 cards checked. Exact-name primary-source searches did not establish a count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count disclosed in the checked sources. Do not infer it from an assumed dense topology or transfer another model count.

architecture.note: Broad classification supported by exact production Opus 4 inclusion, residual-stream layer interventions and transformer/attention discussion. Dense versus MoE, layer dimensions and production parameter counts remain undisclosed; no feature count is used.

context_window.note: Documented context length for exact Opus 4; no inference of current endpoint availability. A May 2026 first-party API pricing table also lists 1M. Retain the directly documented 200K specification and record the unresolved surface/tier discrepancy; pricing alone does not establish availability.

modalities.note: Text and images confirmed for the model; PDF is a supported document input format. Text-to-speech product features do not establish native audio output.

tool_call.note: Parallel tool use and function calling are explicitly documented.

description.value: Claude hybrid reasoning model for coding, complex reasoning, and long-running agent tasks
description.note: Retains supported coding, reasoning and sustained agent use cases; removes undated flagship wording that implies current positioning.

patch.description: Claude hybrid reasoning model for coding, complex reasoning, and long-running agent tasks
patch.notes: Transformer structure is supported by interpretability research on production Opus 4; dense/MoE topology and total/active parameter counts are undisclosed. PDF is a supported document format. The dated snapshot was retired from the Claude API on June 15, 2026; documented specifications do not establish current endpoint operation. An Anthropic pricing PDF effective May 12, 2026 also lists a 1M API tier, conflicting with the retained 200K model specification; availability of that tier was not verified.

sources.label: Anthropic pricing table with conflicting context tier

summary: Adds broad transformer architecture and proprietary license, replaces undated flagship wording, and confirms the other supported baseline facts. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed after original and later first-party card checks. Records current Claude API retirement without changing the historical release date.
